comparison.objective: Open breaker terminals, insert a multi-pin comb busbar and clamp every pin; candidate commissions a shock absorber.

comparison.reason: Fastener use is incidental; electrical multi-insertion and dynamic tuning test different abilities. No material rubric detail is missing.
